description: WCAG color contrast checker — Offline WCAG 2.x contrast check for a text color (fg=) on a background (bg=): hex, #rgb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), hsl() or CSS names; alpha is composited. Returns the contrast ratio, AA/AAA pass for normal and large text (size=large or font_px= and bold=), non-text UI pass, luminance, and the nearest passing fg and bg colors for AA and AAA. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
